faq.description: Have another question? Contact us on Discord or by email.

items.title: What exactly is TinyToolFlare and how does it work?
items.description: TinyToolFlare provides rich online tools covering text processing, image editing, code conversion and many other practical functions. No installation required, free to use.

items.title: Do I need advanced technical skills to use TinyToolFlare?
items.description: While basic programming knowledge is helpful, TinyToolFlare is designed to be developer-friendly. Our templates and documentation make it easy to get started, even if you're not an expert in AI or cloud infrastructure.

items.title: What types of AI SaaS can I build with TinyToolFlare?
items.description: TinyToolFlare supports a wide range of AI applications, from content generation to data analysis tools. Our templates cover popular use cases like AI chatbots, content generators, image processing apps, and more.

items.title: How long does it typically take to launch with TinyToolFlare?
items.description: With TinyToolFlare, you can have a working prototype in hours and a production-ready application in hours. Our one-click deployment and pre-configured infrastructure significantly reduce the traditional months-long development cycle.

items.title: What's included in the TinyToolFlare infrastructure?
items.description: TinyToolFlare provides a complete infrastructure stack including authentication, database setup, API integration, payment processing, and scalable cloud deployment. Everything is pre-configured following industry best practices.

items.title: Can I customize the templates to match my brand?
items.description: Absolutely! All TinyToolFlare templates are fully customizable. You can modify the design, features, and functionality to match your brand identity and specific business requirements while maintaining the robust underlying infrastructure.
